# routeros_ip_kid_control_device (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_ip_kid_control_device" "device" {
  mac_address = "00:00:5E:00:53:01"
  name        = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mac_address` (String) MAC address of the device that is being controlled.
- `name` (String) Name of the device.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___skip___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `user` (String) Name of the Kid Control profile (`/ip/kid-control`) the device is appended to.

### Read-Only

- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/ip/kid-control/device get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_ip_kid_control_device.device "*1"
```
